title: [RPG Design Guides] Status Ailments 1: Problems and Effective Use

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】状態異常① 問題点と有効活用
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Status Ailments 1: Problems and Effective Use

blocks.source: 状態異常（ステータス異常）とは、対象を不利な状態（異常）に変化させる効果である。代表的なものとして、『毒』があるが、これは大抵、時間経過と共にダメージを与える効果を持つ。掛けた時点では数値によるダメージを伴わないという点で、単なる攻撃とは異なる。
blocks.translation: A status ailment (status abnormality) is an effect that changes a target into a disadvantageous state. A representative example is “Poison,” which usually deals damage over time. It differs from a simple attack in that it does not inflict numerical damage at the moment it is applied.

blocks.source: 状態異常は補助効果と同じく、戦闘を数値のやり取りだけで終わらせないためには欠かせない。……なのだが、補助効果と同じく、テクニカルかつ玄人向けで、多くのＲＰＧにおいて、持て余し気味になっているのが現実だ。そんな状態異常に関わる主なポイントをまとめながら、有効活用する方法を考えてみたい。
blocks.translation: Like support effects, status ailments are essential for preventing battles from ending as mere exchanges of numbers. …However, also like support effects, they are technical and geared toward experienced players, and the reality is that they tend to be underused in many RPGs. I would like to consider ways to make effective use of status ailments while summarizing the main points related to them.

blocks.source: 補助効果は多くの場合、味方が味方に掛けることになる。対して状態異常は、敵が味方に仕掛けてくる機会も相当に多い。そのため……
blocks.translation: In many cases, allies apply support effects to other allies. Status ailments, on the other hand, are also frequently inflicted on allies by enemies. Therefore…

blocks.source: 敵が味方に仕掛ける状態異常
blocks.translation: Status ailments inflicted by enemies on allies

blocks.source: 味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常
blocks.translation: Status ailments inflicted by allies on enemies

blocks.source: の２つに分けて考察する。特に『味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常』に付いては、ザコ戦とボス戦でも勝手が大きく異なるので、その点は特に詳しく掘り下げる。
blocks.translation: I will examine these two separately. In particular, the handling of status ailments inflicted by allies on enemies differs greatly between regular battles and boss battles, so I will explore that point in greater detail.

blocks.source: 敵が味方に仕掛ける状態異常
blocks.translation: Status Ailments Inflicted by Enemies on Allies

blocks.source: 敵が使う状態異常は一般的に、プレイヤーから見て『嫌らしい』として嫌われることも多い。
blocks.translation: Status ailments used by enemies are often disliked by players because they feel “nasty.”

blocks.source: だが、本当に嫌らしいだけならば、そもそもＲＰＧにこのような要素は必要もないはず。それでもなお、多くのＲＰＧで採用されるのは、作品を面白くするという観点から見て、以下のような利点があるからだと考えられる。
blocks.translation: However, if they were truly nothing more than unpleasant, there would be no need for such elements in RPGs in the first place. Even so, they continue to be used in many RPGs because they offer the following advantages from the perspective of making a game more interesting.

blocks.source: 使用する異常技によって、敵の差別化ができる。
blocks.translation: Enemies can be differentiated by the abnormality-inducing skills they use.

blocks.source: 混乱や即死など、ランダム要素によるハラハラ感を演出できる。
blocks.translation: Random elements such as confusion and instant death can create a sense of suspense.

blocks.source: 異常を受けた際に、どのように対処するかという戦術性を要求できる。
blocks.translation: They can demand tactical decisions about how to respond when afflicted.

blocks.source: 耐性のある装備品を用意するという戦略性を要求できる。
blocks.translation: They can demand strategic planning, such as preparing equipment with resistances.

blocks.source: 耐性によって、味方キャラクターの差別化ができる。
blocks.translation: Allied characters can be differentiated through their resistances.

blocks.source: やはり、敵の状態異常もＲＰＧには欠かせない要素なのだ。
blocks.translation: After all, status ailments used by enemies are also an essential element of RPGs.

blocks.source: 敵が仕掛ける状態異常のやりすぎに注意
blocks.translation: Be Careful Not to Overuse Status Ailments Inflicted by Enemies

blocks.source: とはいえもちろん、敵の状態異常にも限度というものがある。これが余りにも嫌らしいと、プレイヤーがプレイを放り投げる原因にもなる。特に嫌がられる状況を次にまとめた。
blocks.translation: That said, of course, there are limits to status ailments used by enemies. If they become too nasty, they can even cause players to give up on the game. The situations players find particularly unpleasant are summarized below.

blocks.source: 治療に手間・費用が掛かる。治療手段が不足しがち
blocks.translation: Treatment Takes Time and Money, and Treatment Options Are Often Scarce

blocks.source: 戦闘終了時に自動完治しない状態異常に関しては、ことさら注意が必要だ。
blocks.translation: Extra caution is needed with status ailments that are not automatically cured at the end of battle.

blocks.source: プレイヤーが治療手段を持たない場合は、町に引き返す必要に迫られたりする。これを何度も繰り返すようなバランスだと、プレイが停滞するので、大きなストレス要因ともなる。
blocks.translation: If players have no means of treatment, they may be forced to return to town. If the game balance requires them to repeat this several times, gameplay will stagnate, making it a major source of stress.

blocks.source: お金やＭＰに乏しく、魔法の種類も揃っていない序盤は、状態異常への対処が少なくこの状況に陥りやすい。
blocks.translation: Early in the game, when money and MP are scarce and the player has not yet acquired a full range of spells, there are few ways to deal with status ailments, making this situation particularly likely.

blocks.source: 対処法が無く理不尽
blocks.translation: Unreasonable When There Is No Way to Respond

blocks.source: 状態異常の中でも、即死や石化のような凶悪なものを使う敵に対しては、対処法がない状況にならないようにしたい。ここで言う状態異常に対する対処法とは主に二通り。
blocks.translation: When facing enemies that use particularly deadly status ailments such as instant death or petrification, you should avoid creating situations in which there is no way to respond. There are two main ways to deal with status ailments:

blocks.source: 装備品などで異常を防止する。
blocks.translation: Prevent the ailment with equipment or similar means.

blocks.source: 敵が仕掛けてくる前に倒す。または状態異常で行動を封じる。
blocks.translation: Defeat the enemy before it can use the ailment, or seal its actions with a status ailment.

blocks.source: つまり、装備品で防止できない上に、こちらよりも素早く行動して異常を放ってくる敵はタチが悪いということだ。素早くなくとも、しぶとかったり、状態異常への耐性が高かったりで、行動の妨害が難しい場合も同様に嫌らしい。
blocks.translation: In other words, enemies are especially nasty when their ailments cannot be prevented with equipment and they act faster than the party to inflict them. Even if they are not fast, they are similarly unpleasant if they are tough or highly resistant to status ailments, making it difficult to disrupt their actions.

blocks.source: 生殺し
blocks.translation: Kept Alive

blocks.source: 眠りなどの行動できなくなる状態異常をかけられ続けて、何も身動きできない状況が延々と続くことを指す。中々、全滅もしなければ、逃げられもしないので、プレイヤーは終わるのを待つか、リセットするしか手段がなくなる。
blocks.translation: This refers to a situation in which the party is repeatedly afflicted with status ailments such as Sleep that prevent them from acting, leaving them completely helpless for an extended period. Since the party is neither wiped out nor able to escape, the player has no choice but to wait for it to end or reset the game.

blocks.source: 状態異常を多用するが攻撃力には乏しい敵を、群れで出した場合に陥りやすい。これなら、さっさと全滅させられた方がマシである。
blocks.translation: This is likely to happen when a group of enemies that frequently use status ailments but have low attack power appears. In such cases, it would be better to be wiped out quickly.

blocks.source: 味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常
blocks.translation: Status Ailments Inflicted by Allies on Enemies

blocks.source: 『敵が味方に仕掛ける状態異常』とは異なり、『味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常』には嫌がられる要素は全くない。この点は安心できるのだが、制作者からすると中々に調整が難しい分野でもある。
blocks.translation: Unlike status ailments inflicted by enemies on allies, status ailments inflicted by allies on enemies have no unpleasant aspects at all. This is reassuring, but from a creator’s perspective, it is also a particularly difficult area to balance.

blocks.source: それでは、味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常にはどのような利点があるのだろうか？
blocks.translation: So, what advantages do status ailments inflicted by allies on enemies offer?

blocks.source: 成功確率におけるランダム要素によってハラハラ感を演出できる。
blocks.translation: Randomness in the success rate can create a sense of suspense.

blocks.source: 敵に応じて、異常を使い分ける戦略性・戦術性を付加できる。
blocks.translation: They can add strategic and tactical depth by allowing players to choose different ailments depending on the enemy.

blocks.source: 使用できる異常技によって、味方キャラクターの差別化ができる。
blocks.translation: Allied characters can be differentiated by the abnormality-inducing skills they can use.

blocks.source: 耐性によって、敵の差別化ができる。
blocks.translation: Enemies can be differentiated through their resistances.

blocks.source: 例えば……
blocks.translation: For example…

blocks.source: この敵は数が多い上に、物理攻撃が強い。
blocks.translation: There are many of these enemies, and their physical attacks are powerful.

blocks.source: しかし、敵が行動するまでに倒すのは難しい。
blocks.translation: However, it is difficult to defeat them before they act.

blocks.source: ここは『暗闇』で、命中を下げて攻撃を受ける回数を減らすようにしよう。
blocks.translation: In that case, let’s use “Blindness” to lower their accuracy and reduce the number of attacks we receive.

blocks.source: ……というように判断して戦術を駆使する。うまくハマればニンマリだ。こういう搦手による快感は、単純な攻撃と回復による力押しでは得られないものがある。
blocks.translation: You make a decision like this and employ your tactics. When it works perfectly, it feels great. This kind of satisfaction from using unconventional tactics cannot be achieved through brute force with simple attacks and healing.

blocks.source: 味方に状態異常を活用させるには？
blocks.translation: How Can Allies Make Effective Use of Status Ailments?

blocks.source: そんなわけで、状態異常をうまく使うように設定できれば、戦術の幅が大きく広がる。この場合、第一の関門となるのは、ダメージ攻撃と比較して、状態異常を活用する価値を見い出せるかどうかだ。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, if you can set things up so that status ailments are used effectively, the range of available tactics expands greatly. In this case, the first hurdle is determining whether players can find value in using status ailments compared with simply dealing damage.

blocks.source: 毒でジワジワＨＰを削るぐらいなら、殴ってＨＰを減らした方が早い。
blocks.translation: If you are going to slowly whittle down HP with Poison, it is faster to hit the enemy and reduce its HP directly.

blocks.source: 眠らせて動きを止めるぐらいなら、殴って永眠させた方が早い。
blocks.translation: If you are only going to put an enemy to Sleep and stop it from moving, it is faster to hit it and put it to eternal rest.

blocks.source: 効くかどうかも分からない即死技を使うより、殴って倒した方が確実。
blocks.translation: Rather than use an instant-death skill whose effectiveness is uncertain, it is more reliable to hit the enemy and defeat it.

blocks.source: そもそも状態異常とは、ダメージ攻撃と比較すると回りくどい手段なのだ。上記のような状況を脱しない限り、状態異常技に未来はない。せめて、なんとかする方法はないのだろうか……。
blocks.translation: Status ailments are, to begin with, roundabout methods compared with attacks that deal damage. Unless we can escape the situations described above, status ailment skills have no future. Surely there must be some way to make them work…

blocks.source: というわけで案を挙げてみる。
blocks.translation: So, I will suggest a few ideas.

blocks.source: ＭＰ消費は控えめに
blocks.translation: Keep MP Costs Moderate

blocks.source: 大抵の場合、状態異常技はＭＰ消費を伴うことが多い。そのため、どうせ消費するなら攻撃魔法を使ったほうが良いという状況も多くありえる。更には、消費無しの通常攻撃よりも価値が無いなんてことになると目も当てられない。その点を考慮しても、状態異常技の消費ＭＰは低めを意識しておくと良い。
blocks.translation: In most cases, status ailment skills consume MP. As a result, there will often be situations where, if MP is going to be spent anyway, it would be better to use an offensive spell. It would be even worse if they ended up being less valuable than a normal attack, which costs nothing. With that in mind, it is a good idea to keep the MP cost of status ailment skills relatively low.

blocks.source: 効果範囲を広めに
blocks.translation: Use a Wider Effect Range

blocks.source: 範囲が単体への状態異常技というのは、なかなか使いどころが難しい。やはり「たかが一体の動きを止めたいだけならば、集中的に殴って倒す方が早い」というわけだ。そんなわけで、状態異常技の範囲は全体など、複数を対象としたほうが使いやすい。
blocks.translation: Status ailment skills that target only one enemy can be difficult to find uses for. After all, “If you only want to stop one enemy from moving, it is faster to focus your attacks and defeat it.” For this reason, status ailment skills are easier to use when they target multiple enemies, such as all enemies.

blocks.source: となると、強力過ぎる複数攻撃技は状態異常技の手強いライバルとなる。「簡単に敵全体を一掃できるような技があるなら、状態異常なんていらない」となるのは当然だろう。以前、『戦闘バランス』の記事でも、全体攻撃技の問題点を書いたが、こちらの意味でも無闇に作らないようにしよう。
blocks.translation: In that case, overly powerful skills that attack multiple enemies become formidable rivals to status ailment skills. It is only natural to think, “If there is a skill that can easily wipe out the entire enemy party, there is no need for status ailments.” I previously wrote about the problems with all-enemy attack skills in the “Battle Balance” article, but you should avoid creating them recklessly for this reason as well.

blocks.source: 異常を弱点とする敵を意識して作る
blocks.translation: Design Enemies with Ailments as Weaknesses

blocks.source: しぶといが、即死魔法なら一撃の敵
blocks.translation: A tenacious enemy that can be defeated in one hit with an instant-death spell

blocks.source: しぶといが、毒でのHP減少が有効な敵
blocks.translation: A tenacious enemy whose HP can be effectively reduced with poison

blocks.source: 怪力だが、暗闇は確実に効く敵
blocks.translation: A powerful enemy against whom Blind is guaranteed to work

blocks.source: 硬くて魔法も効かないが、守備力低下が有効な敵
blocks.translation: An enemy with high defense that resists magic but is vulnerable to reduced defense

blocks.source: というように、状態異常を弱点とする敵を明確に意識して作る。これならば、使用機会も生まれるはず。ただし、「硬くて魔法も効かないが、守備力低下が有効」というように、倒すのに手数が必要な敵は、多用しすぎて面倒臭がられないようには注意したい。
blocks.translation: In this way, deliberately design enemies with status ailments as clear weaknesses. This should create opportunities to use them. However, be careful not to overuse enemies that require many actions to defeat, such as ones that are “tough and resistant to magic but vulnerable to reduced defense,” lest they become tedious.

blocks.source: 他にも「鳥は暗闇に弱い」「獣は混乱に弱い」というように、種族などで傾向を付けてみると、プレイヤーが使用機会を測りやすい。
blocks.translation: You can also establish tendencies based on species, such as “Birds are weak against Blind” and “Beasts are weak against Confusion.” This makes it easier for players to judge when to use them.

blocks.source: ダメージ攻撃の追加効果として設定する
blocks.translation: Set Them as Additional Effects of Damage Attacks

blocks.source: 例えば、『ポイズンアタック』というような技を作成する。効果は通常攻撃と同等のダメージを与えた上で、５０％の確率で毒を付加するというもの。これならば、毒が敵に掛からなかったとしても、攻撃のダメージは与えられるため、失敗を恐れずに使いやすい。
blocks.translation: For example, create a skill called “Poison Attack.” Its effect could be to deal damage equal to a normal attack and inflict Poison with a 50% chance. This makes the skill easy to use without fear of failure, since it still deals attack damage even if Poison does not affect the enemy.

blocks.source: ただし、複数の効果を持つということは、戦術としての狙いが絞れず中途半端になりやすいということも指摘できる。「追加の毒がかかった時には、もう敵は死んでいた」となると、普通に殴った方がＭＰの無駄がないだけマシだったなと思われてしまう。
blocks.translation: However, having multiple effects also means that the skill’s tactical purpose can become unfocused and half-hearted. If the result is, “By the time the additional Poison took effect, the enemy was already dead,” players may feel that simply attacking would have been better, since it would have avoided wasting MP.

blocks.source: ボス戦で状態異常を有効活用するには？
blocks.translation: How Can You Make Effective Use of Status Ailments in Boss Battles?

blocks.source: 『味方が使用する状態異常』の中でも、最も難しいのはボス戦での活用だろう。その点をまとめると……
blocks.translation: Of all the “status ailments used by allies,” the most difficult to use effectively is probably in boss battles. To summarize the key points...

blocks.source: 即死、石化などの即死級の異常は当然、ボスには無効にするしかない。
blocks.translation: Ailments such as instant death and paralysis-level effects like petrification must naturally be made ineffective against bosses.

blocks.source: ＨＰの１／４を削る毒のような異常も、強すぎるので無効にするしかない。
blocks.translation: Ailments such as Poison that remove one-fourth of the target’s HP are also too powerful, so they must be made ineffective.

blocks.source: 眠り、マヒなどの動きを止める異常も、簡単に効いてはまずい。
blocks.translation: Ailments that stop movement, such as Sleep and Paralysis, must not work too easily either.

blocks.source: かと言って、低確率で効く設定にしても、運に左右されてしまい使い辛い。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, setting them to have a low chance of working makes them difficult to use because the outcome depends on luck.

blocks.source: 強敵であるボス相手に運試しをしている余裕は無いはず。
blocks.translation: You should not have enough leeway to gamble against a powerful boss.

blocks.source: そもそも、どの状態異常が効くかも分からないなら、
blocks.translation: If you do not even know which status ailments are effective,

blocks.source: 普通にダメージを与えた方が良いと判断されがち。
blocks.translation: players will tend to decide that it is better to simply deal damage.

blocks.source: こういう難しさがあって、結局のところ、ボスには状態異常が一切効かない設定にしているＲＰＧも多い。こうなると、異常技は役立たず。もし、異常技を中心に戦うテクニカルなキャラクターがいた場合、肝心のボス戦ではお払い箱となってしまうのも悲しい。
blocks.translation: Because of these difficulties, many RPGs ultimately make all status ailments ineffective against bosses. When that happens, ailment skills are useless. It is also unfortunate if a technical character who specializes in ailment skills becomes a liability in the crucial boss battles.

blocks.source: そんな不憫な状態異常と、状態異常の使い手に救いの手を差し伸べるべく、ボス戦でなんとか役に立つ方法を考えたい。思いつく限りにアイデアを出してみた。
blocks.translation: To give these unfortunate status ailments and their users a helping hand, I want to consider ways to make them useful in boss battles. I came up with as many ideas as I could.

blocks.source: ボスにお供を付ける
blocks.translation: Give the Boss Minions

blocks.source: ボスのお供としてザコ敵を用意し、こちらには普通に異常が効くようにする。ボス自体には異常が効かなくとも、お供には効果があるので多少の使い道ができる。『即死』『石化』など、強力過ぎて、ボスへは無効にするしかない異常も、ここでなら日の目を見るかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Prepare some weaker enemies as the boss’s minions and let status ailments work normally on them. Even if ailments do not affect the boss itself, they will still be useful against its minions. Powerful ailments such as Instant Death and Petrification, which are too strong to work against the boss, may finally get their chance to shine here.

blocks.source: 比較的、影響が少ない異常を有効に
blocks.translation: Allow Relatively Mild Ailments to Work

blocks.source: 『即死』『石化』など、勝負を決してしまう強力な異常がボスに効いてしまうのはまずい。ならば、以下のように、比較的効果が控えめな異常に限り、ボスにも有効となるように設定する。
blocks.translation: It would be problematic if powerful ailments such as Instant Death and Petrification, which can decide the battle outright, worked on bosses. Instead, set only relatively mild ailments like the following to be effective against bosses.

blocks.source: 防御力減少
blocks.translation: Reduce Defense

blocks.source: ボスの攻撃を妨げるわけではないので、バランスが崩れにくい。後述するが、ＤＱシリーズでも多くのボスに有効な状態異常となっている。
blocks.translation: Since it does not hinder the boss’s attacks, it is less likely to disrupt the balance. As mentioned later, it is also a status ailment that works against many bosses in the Dragon Quest series.

blocks.source: 魔封じ
blocks.translation: Seal Magic

blocks.source: 魔法をあまり使わないボスになら、効くようにしても問題ないはず。魔法を封じた場合は物理攻撃など、魔法以外の攻撃を使うように調整すれば、これだけで極端に弱体化することもなくなる。
blocks.translation: It should be fine to let this work against bosses that do not use magic very often. If you adjust the boss to use non-magical attacks, such as physical attacks, when its magic is sealed, this will prevent it from becoming drastically weaker.

blocks.source: 暴走
blocks.translation: Berserk

blocks.source: ＦＦでいういわゆるバーサク。攻撃しかできなくなるが、攻撃力が上昇するという効果もあって、掛けられた方が単純に不利になるとは限らない。
blocks.translation: This is what is commonly called Berserk in Final Fantasy. The affected target can only attack, but its attack power also increases, so being affected is not necessarily a straightforward disadvantage.

blocks.source: 暗闇（命中率減少）
blocks.translation: Blind (Reduced Accuracy)

blocks.source: 完全に行動を封じられる眠りやマヒのような異常と比較すると、効果は小さい。物理主体のボスには有効である。
blocks.translation: Compared with ailments such as Sleep and Paralysis, which completely prevent action, its effect is minor. It is effective against physically oriented bosses.

blocks.source: ディレイ
blocks.translation: Delay

blocks.source: ＡＴＢやＣＴＢにおいて、行動を遅らせる状態異常のこと。ターン制ならば、１ターン丸々妨害するような技をボスに効くようにすると、ハメ殺しされかねない。だが、ＡＴＢ，ＣＴＢならば微妙な調整が可能だ。0.25～0.5ターン程度、微妙に行動を遅らせるような調整をすれば良いだろう。
blocks.translation: In ATB or CTB systems, this is a status ailment that delays actions. In a turn-based system, allowing a skill that completely disrupts one full turn to work on a boss could lead to an effortless lockout. With ATB or CTB, however, fine adjustments are possible. You could make it delay actions slightly, by around 0.25 to 0.5 turns.

blocks.source: 確率や効果を控えめにする
blocks.translation: Keep the Chance or Effect Modest

blocks.source: ボスに対して異常が効く確率を低くする。あるいは効いたとしても、眠りなどの効果が持続するターン数を短くなるように設定することで、バランスを崩さないようにする。ただし、消極的な方法なので、結局は状態異常自体が使われない可能性も高く、なかなか調整が難しい。
blocks.translation: Lower the chance that ailments will work against bosses. Alternatively, even if they do work, you can preserve balance by shortening the number of turns their effects, such as Sleep, last. However, this is a passive approach, so there is a high chance that status ailments will simply go unused, making them difficult to balance.

blocks.source: 割合効果を使わない
blocks.translation: Do Not Use Percentage-Based Effects

blocks.source: 異常がボス相手に強力過ぎる理由の一つとして、割合効果の問題が挙げられる。割合効果とは「ＨＰの２５％を奪う毒」「攻撃力を半減する魔法」といった対象者のパラメータに対して、割合で作用をもたらす効果のことである。
blocks.translation: One reason ailments are too powerful against bosses is the problem of percentage-based effects. These are effects that act as a percentage of the target’s parameters, such as “Poison that removes 25% of HP” or “A spell that halves attack power.”

blocks.source: 例えば、割合効果の異常がボスに効くと仮定した場合……
blocks.translation: For example, suppose a percentage-based ailment worked against a boss...

blocks.source: 最大ＨＰの１／４を奪い取る毒で、どんなにＨＰが高いボスも４ターンでイチコロ。
blocks.translation: Poison that removes one-fourth of its maximum HP would defeat any boss, no matter how high its HP, in four turns.

blocks.source: 素早さを半減させて、ボスの２倍の手数で袋叩きに。
blocks.translation: Halve its Agility, then pummel it with twice as many actions as the boss.

blocks.source: 怪力自慢のボスも、攻撃力を半減すればヘナチョコに。
blocks.translation: Even a boss famed for its immense strength becomes feeble if its attack power is halved.

blocks.source: という具合に、大きくゲームバランスが狂ってしまう。
blocks.translation: In this way, the game balance would become severely distorted.

blocks.source: なので『割合』を使わないように設定すればよい。例えば……
blocks.translation: Therefore, you should configure them not to use “percentage” effects. For example...

blocks.source: 毒の例
blocks.translation: Example of Poison

blocks.source: 「毒を掛けた側の魔力」を元に毒ダメージを算出する。魔力５０のキャラクターが使用した毒魔法はザコ敵だろうが、ボス敵だろうが、毎ターン５０のダメージを与える効果というようになる。
blocks.translation: Poison damage is calculated based on the “magic power of the character who inflicted the poison.” A poison spell used by a character with 50 magic power will have an effect that deals 50 damage every turn, regardless of whether it is used on a weak enemy or a boss.

blocks.source: 攻撃力減少の例
blocks.translation: Example of Reduced Attack Power

blocks.source: 「魔法を掛けた側の魔力」で攻撃力減少の値を算出する。減少値が２０で、味方の防御力が５０とすると・・・
blocks.translation: The amount of attack power reduction is calculated based on the “magic power of the character who cast the spell.” If the reduction is 20 and an ally’s defense is 50...

blocks.source: ザコの攻撃力：１００→ ８０ に減少。
blocks.translation: Weak enemy’s attack power: 100 → reduced to 80.

blocks.source: [使用前]１００－５０＝ ５０ダメージが
blocks.translation: [Before use] 100 − 50 = 50 damage

blocks.source: [使用後]８０－５０ ＝ ３０ダメージに。
blocks.translation: [After use] 80 − 50 = 30 damage.

blocks.source: ボスの攻撃力：２００→１８０ に減少。
blocks.translation: Boss’s attack power: 200 → reduced to 180.

blocks.source: [使用前]２００－５０＝１５０ダメージが
blocks.translation: [Before use] 200 − 50 = 150 damage
[After use] 180 − 50 = 130 damage.

blocks.source: というように、自然と「ザコ敵には高い効果」「ボスにはそれなりの効果」となるので、ずっとバランスが取りやすくなる。
blocks.translation: As you can see, this naturally results in “a powerful effect against weak enemies” and “a reasonable effect against bosses,” making it much easier to maintain balance.

blocks.source: ＤＱやＦＦなど、多くのＲＰＧがそうしているせいで「毒のダメージはＨＰに比例」「ステータス減少技の効果は元の値をＸＸ％減少」というルールがなんとなくできているのだが、そんな慣習をありがたく守る必要はない。もちろん、『魔力』ではなく、状態異常の効果に影響する専用パラメータを用意しても面白い。
blocks.translation: Because so many RPGs, such as Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy, use these conventions, rules like “poison damage is proportional to HP” and “stat-reducing skills reduce the original value by XX%” have become somewhat commonplace. However, there is no need to blindly follow such conventions. Of course, it could also be interesting to create a dedicated parameter that affects the effectiveness of status ailments instead of using “magic power.”

blocks.source: 確率強化を取り入れる
blocks.translation: Incorporating Chance-Based Enhancements

blocks.source: ボスにも状態異常を効くようにしたい。しかし、ただ単純に技を掛けただけで、異常に掛かってしまうのでは簡単すぎる。かといって、確率を低く設定しても、それはただの運ゲーになってしまう。そこで、プレイヤー側が工夫した場合のみ、状態異常がボス戦で力を発揮するという調整にしてみる。
blocks.translation: I want status ailments to work against bosses, too. However, if simply using a skill causes the ailment to take effect, it would be too easy. On the other hand, setting the success rate too low would make it nothing more than a game of luck. So, I’ll try adjusting things so that status ailments only prove effective in boss battles when the player has used some strategy.

blocks.source: 具体的には……
blocks.translation: More specifically...

blocks.source: キャラクターや職業毎に状態異常の得意・不得意を定める。
blocks.translation: Establish which characters and classes are good or poor at inflicting each status ailment.

blocks.source: 高確率で状態異常を掛けられる技は習得を厳しくする。
blocks.translation: Make skills that inflict status ailments with a high success rate difficult to learn.

blocks.source: 状態異常の成功率を上昇させる装備やスキルを作る。
blocks.translation: Create equipment and skills that increase the success rate of status ailments.

blocks.source: といった設定を行う。
blocks.translation: These are the kinds of settings I would use.

blocks.source: 例えば、暗闇魔法の命中率が９０％とし、ボスの耐性が７０％とする。計算式は単純な引き算として、成功率は２０％となる。このままでは確率が低くて安定しない。
blocks.translation: For example, suppose a darkness spell has a 90% hit rate and the boss has 70% resistance. Using simple subtraction, the success rate would be 20%. At that rate, it would be too low to rely on.

blocks.source: そこで、プレイヤーが上記にあるような工夫をすることで、命中率を１５０％に引き上げる。成功率は８０％となって、安定して戦術に組み入れられるようになるという寸法だ。
blocks.translation: The player could then use the kinds of strategies described above to raise the hit rate to 150%. This would result in an 80% success rate, making it reliable enough to incorporate into their tactics.

blocks.source: 免疫を付けてみる
blocks.translation: Trying Out Immunity

blocks.source: これはまだ練込途中のアイデアだけど紹介。免疫という概念を設けて、一戦闘中は同じ異常が何度も効かないようにする。例えば、最初の一回は眠りが１００％の確率で効くが、再度掛けた時には５０％でしか効かないというようにだ。これによって、異常技の連発によるハメ殺しを禁止する。
blocks.translation: This is still an idea I’m working on, but I’ll introduce it anyway. Establish the concept of immunity so that the same ailment becomes less effective each time it is inflicted during a battle. For example, sleep might work with a 100% chance the first time, but only a 50% chance when inflicted again. This prevents players from repeatedly using ailment skills to lock down and defeat an enemy.

blocks.source: ただし、これだとボス戦が佳境になってから、異常をかけて、一気にやっつけるような戦法が有利になりそうな気がする。戦闘終盤のほうが緊張感がなくなる状況になりそうなのは欠点かも……。
blocks.translation: However, with this system, a strategy of inflicting an ailment late in a boss battle and then finishing the boss off all at once might become advantageous. It could be a drawback if battles become less tense toward the end...

blocks.source: 市販ＲＰＧのボス戦はどうなっているか？
blocks.translation: What Are Boss Battles Like in Commercial RPGs?

blocks.source: 実は意外かもしれないが、ＤＱやＦＦシリーズでは、ボスにも状態異常が効く設定になっている場合が多い。プレイヤーが気付きさえすればだが、状態異常は既存の市販ＲＰＧにおけるボス戦でも案外、役に立つのだ。
blocks.translation: This may be surprising, but in many cases, the Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy series allow status ailments to affect bosses as well. As long as the player notices this, status ailments can be surprisingly useful even in boss battles in existing commercial RPGs.

blocks.source: 参考までに紹介してみる。
blocks.translation: I’ll introduce a few examples for reference.

blocks.source: ＤＱシリーズ
blocks.translation: The Dragon Quest Series

blocks.source: 特に有名なのはＤＱ３のバラモス。ラリホー（眠り）、ルカニ（守備力低下）、マホトーン（呪文封じ）、マヌーサ（命中率低下）と４つもの状態異常が有効。さすがに、即死や混乱は効かない。
blocks.translation: One particularly famous example is Baramos in Dragon Quest III. Four status ailments are effective against him: Snooze (sleep), Sap (reduced defense), Fizzle (spell sealing), and Fuddle (reduced hit rate). Instant death and confusion, unsurprisingly, do not work.

blocks.source: ちなみに、マホトーンで呪文を封じた場合、攻撃呪文を使わなくなるため結果的に、打撃と炎の息の頻度が上がるので、そこまでの弱体化はしなかったりする。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, if Fizzle seals his spells, he stops using offensive spells, which consequently increases the frequency of his physical attacks and flame breath. As a result, it does not actually weaken him all that much.

blocks.source: また、ラスボスには守備力低下しか異常は効かない。おまけに凍てつく波動で打ち消してくるため、使い所がやや難しい。
blocks.translation: Also, the only ailment that works on the final boss is reduced defense. To make matters worse, the boss dispels it with Wave of Ice, making it somewhat difficult to find the right time to use.

blocks.source: シリーズ全体を通して、ボス戦で状態異常を使う機会は少ない。しかし、一貫して守備力低下だけは有効な局面が多い。ＳＦＣ版ＤＱ２のラスボスに至っては守備力を下げない限り、まず勝ち目はないので、使用が前提となっているように思える。
blocks.translation: Throughout the series, there are few opportunities to use status ailments in boss battles. However, reduced defense is consistently effective in many situations. In the SFC version of Dragon Quest II, in particular, you have virtually no chance of defeating the final boss without lowering its defense, so it seems to be intended as a prerequisite.

blocks.source: ＦＦシリーズ
blocks.translation: The Final Fantasy Series

blocks.source: ＦＦ５では、数多くのボス敵に状態異常が効く。特に耐性が無い敵にも、必ず効果を与える魔法剣は強力。沈黙や石化で無力化、瞬殺できるボスも多数。極めつけは４つあるラスボスのパーツの中には、即死攻撃が有効なものまであるということ。
blocks.translation: In Final Fantasy V, status ailments work on many bosses. Spellblades are especially powerful because they always inflict their effects even on enemies without resistance. Many bosses can be rendered helpless or instantly killed with Silence or Petrify. To top it off, one of the four parts of the final boss is even vulnerable to instant-death attacks.

blocks.source: 他にも、『すべてをしるもの』という魔法しか使わないボスがいるのだが、これにバーサクを掛けて魔法を封じると、高威力の攻撃を仕掛けてくるという罠がある。状態異常を仕掛けても、単純に楽になるのではなく、別の展開になるというのも面白い。
blocks.translation: There is also a boss called All-Knowing who only uses magic. However, if you cast Berserk on it to seal its magic, it will launch high-powered attacks instead—a nasty trap. It is interesting that inflicting a status ailment does not simply make the battle easier, but can lead to an entirely different turn of events.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 今回は状態異常の全般的な問題と、有効活用に付いてまとめた。状態異常というのは、中々に扱いが難しいのだが、これを機能させることで、一段上の戦略・戦術性を目指したいところ。
blocks.translation: This time, I summarized the general issues surrounding status ailments and how to use them effectively. Status ailments are quite difficult to handle, but by making them function properly, I hope to achieve a higher level of strategy and tactics.

blocks.source: 次回は具体的にどのような状態異常があるかを個別に洗い出し、分類していきたい。
blocks.translation: Next time, I would like to identify and classify the specific status ailments that can be used.

lines.translation: [[LINK_1]]>Return to the RPG Design Guides index[[/LINK_1]]

texts.状態異常（ステータス異常）とは、対象を不利な状態（異常）に変化させる効果である。: A status ailment (status abnormality) is an effect that changes a target into a disadvantageous state. A representative example is “Poison,” which usually deals damage over time. It differs from a simple attack in that it does not inflict numerical damage at the moment it is applied.
texts.状態異常は補助効果と同じく、戦闘を数値のやり取りだけで終わらせないためには欠かせ: Like support effects, status ailments are essential for preventing battles from ending as mere exchanges of numbers. …However, also like support effects, they are technical and geared toward experienced players, and the reality is that they tend to be underused in many RPGs. I would like to consider ways to make effective use of status ailments while summarizing the main points related to them.
texts.補助効果は多くの場合、味方が味方に掛けることになる。対して状態異常は、敵が味方に: In many cases, allies apply support effects to other allies. Status ailments, on the other hand, are also frequently inflicted on allies by enemies. Therefore…
texts.敵が味方に仕掛ける状態異常: Status Ailments Inflicted by Enemies on Allies
texts.味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常: Status Ailments Inflicted by Allies on Enemies
texts.の２つに分けて考察する。特に『味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常』に付いては、ザコ戦とボ: I will examine these two separately. In particular, the handling of status ailments inflicted by allies on enemies differs greatly between regular battles and boss battles, so I will explore that point in greater detail.
texts.敵が使う状態異常は一般的に、プレイヤーから見て『嫌らしい』として嫌われることも多: Status ailments used by enemies are often disliked by players because they feel “nasty.”
texts.だが、本当に嫌らしいだけならば、そもそもＲＰＧにこのような要素は必要もないはず。: However, if they were truly nothing more than unpleasant, there would be no need for such elements in RPGs in the first place. Even so, they continue to be used in many RPGs because they offer the following advantages from the perspective of making a game more interesting.
texts.使用する異常技によって、敵の差別化ができる。: Enemies can be differentiated by the abnormality-inducing skills they use.
texts.混乱や即死など、ランダム要素によるハラハラ感を演出できる。: Random elements such as confusion and instant death can create a sense of suspense.
texts.異常を受けた際に、どのように対処するかという戦術性を要求できる。: They can demand tactical decisions about how to respond when afflicted.
texts.耐性のある装備品を用意するという戦略性を要求できる。: They can demand strategic planning, such as preparing equipment with resistances.
texts.耐性によって、味方キャラクターの差別化ができる。: Allied characters can be differentiated through their resistances.
texts.やはり、敵の状態異常もＲＰＧには欠かせない要素なのだ。: After all, status ailments used by enemies are also an essential element of RPGs.
texts.敵が仕掛ける状態異常のやりすぎに注意: Be Careful Not to Overuse Status Ailments Inflicted by Enemies
texts.とはいえもちろん、敵の状態異常にも限度というものがある。これが余りにも嫌らしいと: That said, of course, there are limits to status ailments used by enemies. If they become too nasty, they can even cause players to give up on the game. The situations players find particularly unpleasant are summarized below.
texts.治療に手間・費用が掛かる。治療手段が不足しがち: Treatment Takes Time and Money, and Treatment Options Are Often Scarce
texts.戦闘終了時に自動完治しない状態異常に関しては、ことさら注意が必要だ。: Extra caution is needed with status ailments that are not automatically cured at the end of battle.
texts.プレイヤーが治療手段を持たない場合は、町に引き返す必要に迫られたりする。これを何: If players have no means of treatment, they may be forced to return to town. If the game balance requires them to repeat this several times, gameplay will stagnate, making it a major source of stress.
texts.お金やＭＰに乏しく、魔法の種類も揃っていない序盤は、状態異常への対処が少なくこの: Early in the game, when money and MP are scarce and the player has not yet acquired a full range of spells, there are few ways to deal with status ailments, making this situation particularly likely.
texts.対処法が無く理不尽: Unreasonable When There Is No Way to Respond
texts.状態異常の中でも、即死や石化のような凶悪なものを使う敵に対しては、対処法がない状: When facing enemies that use particularly deadly status ailments such as instant death or petrification, you should avoid creating situations in which there is no way to respond. There are two main ways to deal with status ailments:
texts.装備品などで異常を防止する。: Prevent the ailment with equipment or similar means.
texts.敵が仕掛けてくる前に倒す。または状態異常で行動を封じる。: Defeat the enemy before it can use the ailment, or seal its actions with a status ailment.
texts.つまり、装備品で防止できない上に、こちらよりも素早く行動して異常を放ってくる敵は: In other words, enemies are especially nasty when their ailments cannot be prevented with equipment and they act faster than the party to inflict them. Even if they are not fast, they are similarly unpleasant if they are tough or highly resistant to status ailments, making it difficult to disrupt their actions.
texts.眠りなどの行動できなくなる状態異常をかけられ続けて、何も身動きできない状況が延々: This refers to a situation in which the party is repeatedly afflicted with status ailments such as Sleep that prevent them from acting, leaving them completely helpless for an extended period. Since the party is neither wiped out nor able to escape, the player has no choice but to wait for it to end or reset the game.
texts.状態異常を多用するが攻撃力には乏しい敵を、群れで出した場合に陥りやすい。これなら: This is likely to happen when a group of enemies that frequently use status ailments but have low attack power appears. In such cases, it would be better to be wiped out quickly.
texts.『敵が味方に仕掛ける状態異常』とは異なり、『味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常』には嫌が: Unlike status ailments inflicted by enemies on allies, status ailments inflicted by allies on enemies have no unpleasant aspects at all. This is reassuring, but from a creator’s perspective, it is also a particularly difficult area to balance.
texts.それでは、味方が敵に仕掛ける状態異常にはどのような利点があるのだろうか？: So, what advantages do status ailments inflicted by allies on enemies offer?
texts.成功確率におけるランダム要素によってハラハラ感を演出できる。: Randomness in the success rate can create a sense of suspense.
texts.敵に応じて、異常を使い分ける戦略性・戦術性を付加できる。: They can add strategic and tactical depth by allowing players to choose different ailments depending on the enemy.
texts.使用できる異常技によって、味方キャラクターの差別化ができる。: Allied characters can be differentiated by the abnormality-inducing skills they can use.
texts.耐性によって、敵の差別化ができる。: Enemies can be differentiated through their resistances.
texts.この敵は数が多い上に、物理攻撃が強い。: There are many of these enemies, and their physical attacks are powerful.
texts.しかし、敵が行動するまでに倒すのは難しい。: However, it is difficult to defeat them before they act.
texts.ここは『暗闇』で、命中を下げて攻撃を受ける回数を減らすようにしよう。: In that case, let’s use “Blindness” to lower their accuracy and reduce the number of attacks we receive.
texts.……というように判断して戦術を駆使する。うまくハマればニンマリだ。こういう搦手に: You make a decision like this and employ your tactics. When it works perfectly, it feels great. This kind of satisfaction from using unconventional tactics cannot be achieved through brute force with simple attacks and healing.
texts.味方に状態異常を活用させるには？: How Can Allies Make Effective Use of Status Ailments?
texts.そんなわけで、状態異常をうまく使うように設定できれば、戦術の幅が大きく広がる。こ: With that in mind, if you can set things up so that status ailments are used effectively, the range of available tactics expands greatly. In this case, the first hurdle is determining whether players can find value in using status ailments compared with simply dealing damage.
texts.毒でジワジワＨＰを削るぐらいなら、殴ってＨＰを減らした方が早い。: If you are going to slowly whittle down HP with Poison, it is faster to hit the enemy and reduce its HP directly.
texts.眠らせて動きを止めるぐらいなら、殴って永眠させた方が早い。: If you are only going to put an enemy to Sleep and stop it from moving, it is faster to hit it and put it to eternal rest.
texts.効くかどうかも分からない即死技を使うより、殴って倒した方が確実。: Rather than use an instant-death skill whose effectiveness is uncertain, it is more reliable to hit the enemy and defeat it.
texts.そもそも状態異常とは、ダメージ攻撃と比較すると回りくどい手段なのだ。上記のような: Status ailments are, to begin with, roundabout methods compared with attacks that deal damage. Unless we can escape the situations described above, status ailment skills have no future. Surely there must be some way to make them work…
texts.というわけで案を挙げてみる。: So, I will suggest a few ideas.
texts.大抵の場合、状態異常技はＭＰ消費を伴うことが多い。そのため、どうせ消費するなら攻: In most cases, status ailment skills consume MP. As a result, there will often be situations where, if MP is going to be spent anyway, it would be better to use an offensive spell. It would be even worse if they ended up being less valuable than a normal attack, which costs nothing. With that in mind, it is a good idea to keep the MP cost of status ailment skills relatively low.
texts.範囲が単体への状態異常技というのは、なかなか使いどころが難しい。やはり「たかが一: Status ailment skills that target only one enemy can be difficult to find uses for. texts.異常を弱点とする敵を意識して作る: Design Enemies with Ailments as Weaknesses
